ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80-85% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) to 15-20% low-intensity pixels (dark black/grey) on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous blocks covering the interior of both lobes. A high-contrast dark perimeter follows the trailing edge and fluke tips. A vertical dark band of mottled low-intensity pixels is located at the central axis, extending from the insertion point to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel divergence of approximately 105 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 2-5 pixels along the trailing edge, most concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small (2-6 pixel diameter) circular dark clusters scattered across the white field of both lobes, particularly visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal dark linear disruptions visible near the distal tip of the right lobe and one small diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense dark scarring and irregular pigmentation at the center base/peduncle insertion area.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular spot located in the mid-region of the right lobe.
